metadata.title: Eliminating the Higgs field and perturbing Yang-Mills connections in cone Yang-Mills theory
metadata.abstract: We study the configurations of the cone Yang-Mills functional over a closed connected manifold. We show that the Euler-Lagrange equation from variations in the Higgs field is always uniquely solvable for $\zeta \neq 0$, allowing us to eliminate one of the two equations from the theory. By eliminating the equation, we obtain a family of ``effective cone Yang-Mills functionals'' on the space of connection 1-forms indexed by $\zeta$, which reduce to Yang-Mills theory when $\zeta = 0$. This suggests a way to nontrivially deform the Yang-Mills moduli space. We take the first step towards this deformation by showing that, near certain critical points of the Yang-Mills functional, there is a family of smooth connections $A_t$ which satisfy the $t\zeta$-cone Yang-Mills equations.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: cone Yang–Mills 方程的有效约化
analysis.workSummary: 证明非零参数下 Higgs 变分方程总可唯一求解，从而消去 Higgs 场形成连接空间上的有效 cone Yang–Mills 泛函，并在某些 Yang–Mills 临界点附近构造光滑解族。
analysis.breakthrough: 为变形 Yang–Mills 模空间提供局部实现机制。
analysis.limitations: 零参数是回到通常理论的极限；局部扰动只在指定临界点附近，尚非整个模空间的全局形变。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 规范方程的约化与扰动工具，应用范围应按非退化等条件核对。
